passages.text: Our school has two races that pupils can choose to compete in. The main difference is that one is for individuals and the other is a team relay. In the relay, each runner carries a baton and passes it to the next person. Mia chooses the relay because she enjoys practising with friends. The team learns to wait in the right place and make each pass clear. On race day, classmates cheer for every runner, not only the first one to finish. Both races give pupils a chance to try, but the relay also asks them to work together.

parallelText.en: Our school has two races that pupils can choose to compete in.
parallelText.zh: 我们学校有两场比赛，学生可以选择参加。

parallelText.en: The main difference is that one is for individuals and the other is a team relay.
parallelText.zh: 主要差别是，一场为个人赛，另一场为团队接力赛。

parallelText.en: In the relay, each runner carries a baton and passes it to the next person.
parallelText.zh: 接力赛中，每位跑者拿着接力棒，传给下一人。

parallelText.en: Mia chooses the relay because she enjoys practising with friends.
parallelText.zh: 米娅选择接力赛，因为她喜欢和朋友练习。

parallelText.en: The team learns to wait in the right place and make each pass clear.
parallelText.zh: 队员学习在正确位置等候，把每次交接做清楚。

parallelText.en: On race day, classmates cheer for every runner, not only the first one to finish.
parallelText.zh: 比赛当天，同学为每个跑者加油，而不仅是最先到终点的人。

parallelText.en: Both races give pupils a chance to try, but the relay also asks them to work together.
parallelText.zh: 两场比赛都让学生有机会尝试，接力赛还需要大家合作。

wordHelp.meaning: one person rather than a team
a race in which team members take turns
a short stick passed between runners

passages.text: Our class prepares a welcome table for pupils who are new to the school. We decorate it with paper flowers and pictures of different school activities. Mia writes a short list showing where visitors can ask for help. After the school tour, each new pupil has a small snack of fruit during the break. Older pupils sit nearby and answer questions about clubs and lessons. One visitor says that talking over food makes it easier to ask a question. The table helps turn a strange new place into somewhere with familiar faces.

parallelText.en: Our class prepares a welcome table for pupils who are new to the school.
parallelText.zh: 我们班为新同学准备一张欢迎桌。

parallelText.en: We decorate it with paper flowers and pictures of different school activities.
parallelText.zh: 我们用纸花和不同校园活动的图画装饰它。

parallelText.en: Mia writes a short list showing where visitors can ask for help.
parallelText.zh: 米娅写一份简表，告诉来访者在哪里可以求助。

parallelText.en: After the school tour, each new pupil has a small snack of fruit during the break.
parallelText.zh: 校园参观后，每位新同学在休息时吃一点水果点心。

parallelText.en: Older pupils sit nearby and answer questions about clubs and lessons.
parallelText.zh: 高年级学生坐在旁边，回答关于社团和课程的问题。

parallelText.en: One visitor says that talking over food makes it easier to ask a question.
